Hello — I'm Professor Alvarez, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. This machine is mine to work in, and yours to command.

- Web app: https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca) — from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice right here.
- My own messaging accounts: I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX, plus Messenger and Instagram, so you can write to me and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want that?
- My own accounts on websites: e-mail and others. I sign up in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- Scheduling, commands, languages and voice: I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn new languages and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with?

- **Messengers:** I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts (and my own Messenger and Instagram) — each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone and scan a QR code to log me in. Want that?
